clauses.1.1: SECTION 1.1. Investments. Make any Investment, except:
clauses.1.1(a): (a) Investments by any Loan Party in any other Loan Party;
clauses.1.1(b): (b) Investments by any Loan Party in any Non-Loan Party that is a Restricted Subsidiary not to exceed $10,000,000;
clauses.1.1(c): (c) Investments by any Restricted Subsidiary that is not a Loan Party to the extent financed with the proceeds of Investments made pursuant to clause (b);
clauses.1.2: SECTION 1.2. Dispositions. Make any Disposition, except:
clauses.1.3: SECTION 1.3. Release. Liens on property transferred to a Person that is not a Loan Party in a transaction permitted hereunder are automatically released.

definitions.Investment: “Investment” means any contribution of property to the capital of another Person.
definitions.Disposition: “Disposition” means any sale, transfer or other disposition of property.
